C9000372.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 372 (Global uniqueness in smooth isotropic elasticity.; papers: Global Uniqueness for the Smooth Isotropic Elasticity Inverse Problem; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/372.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_PF_SCOPE.statement: Planar frames and matrix WKB expansions are prior art. No exterior normalization, auxiliary-to-physical boundary transfer, or downstream uniqueness claim is assumed.

C_PF_JET_IDENTITIES.statement: The augmented identity, scalar-Laplacian normalization, null conjugations, and transport-compatibility identity hold for unrestricted smooth jets.

C_PF_ALGEBRA.statement: The augmented and degree-one compatibility identities imply each next normal-source compatibility; finite vector residuals and divergence constraints telescope for every truncation order.

C_PF_PLANAR.statement: Arbitrary smooth planar matrix systems admit local-parameter invertible disk frames and inhomogeneous solutions preserving compact transverse support.

C_PF_SOLVABILITY.statement: A supported augmented Carleman estimate and its physical adjoint restriction yield an L2 right inverse for conjugated elasticity, uniformly for large tau.

C_PF_INTERIOR.statement: Scaled interior system estimates control two correction derivatives and all higher local derivatives with constants uniform as h tends to zero.

C_PF_RECURSION.statement: Every smooth constrained leading column has compatible amplitudes of every finite order on shrinking disks, preserving the same compact transverse support.

C_PF_CORRECTION.statement: Compatible truncations have physical residual O(tau^(1-N)); physical correction has actual-divergence size O(tau^(2-N)) and the requisite weighted derivative bounds.

C_PF_PROPOSITION.statement: Proposition prop:physical-amplitudes: for every admissible smooth coefficient pair and every nonzero bilinear null direction, a transversely supported local rank-three frame is realized by exact physical pairs with strong actual-divergence convergence and O(tau) weighted first derivatives.

C_PF_PROFILE.statement: Stronger scoped theorem: all smooth actual physical leading profiles satisfy the constrained system; every smooth compact-transverse constrained column admits an exact realization with a complete compatible C-infinity expansion on a smaller ball.

C_PF_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.statement: An independent Reviewer must replay the certificate, assess the complete analytic proof and statement fidelity, independently confirm external propositions, and decide publishable significance and verified novelty.

C_BOUNDARY_TRANSFER.statement: The common-extension and physical-transfer statements in boundary-reduction.tex, under equality of the physical displacement-to-traction maps.

C_TRANSPORT_MATCHING.statement: Proposition prop:transport-matching constructs the supported smooth comparison, holomorphic in projective null direction; not certified in this mission.

C_CONIC_RIGIDITY.statement: Lemma lem:conic-bundle and Proposition prop:comparison-rigidity force the comparison to be the identity; coefficient recovery then uses Lemma lem:finite-type. None is certified in this mission.

C_MAIN_UNIQUENESS.statement: Theorem thm:main asserts equality of both smooth isotropic elastic moduli from equality of their physical boundary maps on every bounded connected smooth domain under mu>0 and 3lambda+2mu>0.
